steps.content: After you vanquish the final of Yugu's controlled spirits, the mist dissipates, only to reveal Yugu herself has disappeared without a trace. The hall now stands utterly empty—no storyteller, no audience, nothing remains.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Right here.
Yugu's soft whisper tickles your ear, sending chills down your spine, compelling you to hurriedly whirl around.
[Release the shackles]
The crimson light slices through the tea tables like a razor through paper, tearing apart space itself—yet it fails to cut short her increasingly gleeful laughter.
In a daze, Yugu's silhouette appears and vanishes throughout the building, always dancing at the edges of your vision.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Ah, such resolve. Are you attempting to dispel this illusion, rouse all from their reveries, and return to your world? What purpose does targeting me serve?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: If indeed this realm is tangible, the wisteria spirit would be the true culprit, with your dear Yingying as the orchestrator of this nightmare—you should seek her out instead. However, if everything here is but a fabrication, as you assert, a mere narrative woven by a taleteller...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: The real me should have already been imprisoned in the real world by the real you, restrained so tightly that even wings would not aid in my escape. So why tire yourself rushing here to confront me?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Still taking me for a fool? In the entire Bureau, only OwO and I fell under the illusion—and it happened right when you were telling your story. That's when the wisteria spirit infiltrated DisCity. You're behind all of this.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: And you deliberately hid in this fabricated world. If I didn't come in after you, what was I supposed to do? Stand out there and rage at your soulless body, huh?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: My, how mistaken you are. I witnessed your plight at the fete, lost in pursuit of the flower spirit. Seeing no headway in the rescue, I dared to venture into this realm to offer you my assistance.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: After all, you appear utterly clueless when it comes to dealing with spirits. Did you truly believe that sheer aggression and brute strength alone could suffice to slay evil and uphold justice?
With her folding fan, she mockingly toys with the luminous thorns of your shackles.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Or perhaps you intend to chant divine scriptures to those wicked spirits? To preach ethics, propriety, and moral values until they grasp the enlightenment and transform from sinners to saints?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Heh heh, do you not see the futility in such an approach? A narrative so lackluster would never enthrall an audience, let alone tame a malevolent spirit!
...Do you really love him that much? You've never even met, or spent any time together.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: I have concealed the key to your predicament within my previous tale, hoping to guide you discreetly. If you had only been more patient and listened until the end, all would unveil itself with utmost clarity.
—Tales again. You've grown sick of her endless "tales," wanting only to condemn her, defeat her, and capture her.

However, your shackles defy your commands as the repercussions of your drained life tighten their grip. Wisps of smoke frolic before your eyes, toying with your mind. It dawns on you that Yugu is employing her power to compel you to hear the rest of her narrative.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Across the myriad of peculiar tales weaved through time, a common thread binds the most popular narratives of malevolent spirits—their protagonists seldom required profound spiritual prowess to tame those entities.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: They either possess charm that bewitches at first sight, or wealth so vast it could make spirits bow to their will.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: And if nothing else, consider the young scholar from my earlier tale—the earnestness in his words so profound that it convinced the ghost of the authenticity of his love, touching her very soul. Given enough time, even the coldest heart can thaw in the warmth of true affection.
steps.female_content: And if nothing else, consider the young maiden from my earlier tale—the earnestness in her words so profound that it convinced the ghost of the authenticity of her love, touching the ghost's very soul. Given enough time, even the coldest heart can thaw in the warmth of true affection.

steps.content: Standing on her stage, her words coil around you like serpents, slithering into your mind. Her voice draws nearer and nearer until you sense her grinning presence mere inches from you.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Love blossoms from three yearnings: beauty, power, and genuine affection. Master just one or two, and not only will you persuade the wisteria spirit to amend her ways and spare your people—she might even sacrifice herself for your cause. Who can say? You might even amass an entire legion of spirits and fiends under your sway.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: My dear guest, have you grasped the meaning of my tale?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: In these mystical tales, the best way to tame a spirit is to become a charming <color=#fb9259>heart-taker</color>—to make them fall helplessly, desperately in love with you!
In the midst of her playful words, she flings her sleeve—and suddenly, a horde of alluring spectral women surge forth, lunging toward you!

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Get out of here!
The crimson light tears through the ghostly veils, only to reveal a book hurtling towards you. You catch it reflexively. Though written in Eastian script, you realize you can understand the title—
Of all things, it's called Chronicles of Romance and Lust.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Every secret technique, triumphant tale, and mystical artifact that guarantees victory—it is all inscribed herein. While countless have beseeched me for this tome, my response has always been denial. Yet now, I present it unto you as a gift.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: I am certain that each word will resonate with you, my dear listener.
You hurl the book away in disgust, refusing to let it sully your hands.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Not everyone in DisCity has a taste for such wicked schemes—especially not when you're causing this kind of trouble.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ..."Tales of the most exquisite beauty," said you? Don't you hear how absurd that sounds?
Seeing your anger, she responds with a soft laugh.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Yet this is precisely what captivates the audience, rendering it beautiful and entertaining in its own way. Did you not find delight on your first visit here?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: If existence is already laden with tribulations, why must narratives burden people further? What harm lies in offering the audience what they yearn for—stories of desire, love, and enchantment? For in truth, I too hold dear their smiles.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Or perhaps, you prefer something more... unorthodox?
Her smile grows deeper as she fixes you with an intense, penetrating gaze.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Indeed, I have heard of your encounters—the Black Rings, calamities, bitter hatred, painful partings, the grand drama of life and death. Each one eclipses my humble tales of spirits by far.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Such tales might not please the common ear, but I find them... fascinating.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: If you'd be willing to share them with me, I could write something beyond my usual tales of romance and folly... something "truly" remarkable.
The air grows cold as she turns to you, her gaze a disturbing blend of sincerity and hunger that sends a chill down your spine.
Soon, you recognize that creeping sensation as anger, and your composure quickly returns.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: If solving your little game requires following your "guidance," fine—I'll play along. But my struggles, my past, my joys and sorrows... they're not for your entertainment. These experiences belong to me alone.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Your pursuit of stories is nothing but watching others suffer from a safe distance, deriving pleasure from their pain. Your so-called "protagonists" are just toys to you. I have no interest in dealing with someone like you, and I don't want to waste my time on you.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Just a friendly reminder—when setting your traps, you might consider being more careful.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Or your toy might just tear your stories apart.

steps.content: After a long, tense stare, you decide there's nothing more to be said and walk away.
Just before you step through the gate, Yugu's voice reaches you from behind.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Aren't you curious about the ending of that ghost romance tale, Chief?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I'd rather not risk being affected by your fate-spinning. Let's write our own story from here on—I'm sure we'll both have plenty of surprises in store for each other.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Heh... Very well, very well.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: I eagerly await what's to come.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Though their love burned bright through the years, the divide between mortal and ghost proved insurmountable. Even in her redemption, the ghostly bride remained a creature of darkness and malice, sapping her beloved of his vitality. Despite pledges of everlasting togetherness, the scholar withered away, his existence waning like the setting sun.
steps.female_content: Though their love burned bright through the years, the divide between mortal and ghost proved insurmountable. Even in her redemption, the ghostly bride remained a creature of darkness and malice, sapping her beloved of her vitality. Despite pledges of everlasting togetherness, the maiden withered away, her existence waning like the setting sun.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: And thus, under the veil of a moonlit night, the ghostly bride vanished. In her wake arrived a wise monk, offering the scholar a golden pill of remedy. At once his vitality returned, his ailment cured. Yet as soon as his health rebounded, the scholar anxiously inquired about the whereabouts of his vanished beloved.
steps.female_content: And thus, under the veil of a moonlit night, the ghostly bride vanished. In her wake arrived a wise monk, offering the maiden a golden pill of remedy. At once her vitality returned, her ailment cured. Yet as soon as her health rebounded, the maiden anxiously inquired about the whereabouts of her vanished beloved.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Where, indeed... The monk offered no answer, merely uttering, "The debt is paid. Let it go." And thus concludes this tale, a most... joyous ending.

steps.speaker: Option
options: ...Your audience also enjoys this kind of story?

steps.content: She keeps smiling at you. After what feels like an eternity, she finally speaks in a soft voice.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: No, this is the kind of story <color=#fb9259>I</color> personally relish... I adore it so very much.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Go on then, my dear protagonist. I look forward to your... interpretation.
You say nothing more and stride out of her House of Tales, with her meaningful gaze following your every step.
